title: What is OAuth? Apps connected without passwords | 50agents
description: OAuth lets one app act in another on your behalf without your password: you approve what it may do, and it gets a token you can take back.
definition: OAuth is the standard way to let one app act in another on your behalf without handing over your password: you sign in to the other app, see what is being asked for, and approve.
The app then holds a token limited to what you approved, which you can take back at any time from the other app's settings.

example.why: The invoices desk sends reminders from your Gmail. Google's own sign-in window lists what is asked for and you approve there; 50agents never sees your Google password.
